text:
Finish only the already-authorized adaptation revision. Preserve all accepted requirements, external operations, actual per-product navigation, row contracts, max ten/order/repetitions, writer-derived filePath, existing runtime guards and cleanup. The revision-6 plan compiles but still passes href/reference/actions into global product selection and resolves only learned candidate records, not original Browser records. Correct these two remaining review findings; preserve unrelated work.

Make extract_search_page_views.searchPageViews.items.candidates.items exactly {candidateId: required string, nameText: required string}, with candidateId copied from the observed record.reference and nameText copied from observed record.text. Do not manufacture IDs. Remove href/reference/actions/labels from this decision contract; keep authoritative action data exclusively in retained original records. Remove unused pageId/visibleTexts fields from the page view; retain the bounded candidates array and observed blockingEvidence array. Empty candidates/evidence arrays mean this page was examined and no such observation exists. Keep each over every complete page. select_search_product_ids then receives only those compact candidate fields and blocking evidence, with unchanged max-ten ID output and blocker handling.

Project original records separately using an existing pure foreach over bind_search_pages.pages: inside each item export records=field(item,"records"); flatten the collected record arrays exactly once. Do not use inference or copy an observation snapshot into interpretation. Keep all original fields intact.

Keep the first lookup against offered compact candidates with key candidateId. From its returned records, use a pure foreach item projection to collect candidateId values in selected order (including repetitions). Then lookup those IDs against the retained original Browser records using the producer field reference as identity key. The product business foreach iterates this second lookup result. Its URL is field(item,"href") from that original record, with the existing non-null guard; its observed fallback name is field(item,"text"). Do not regenerate URLs/selectors, coerce IDs, deduplicate or filter original observations. If producer identity is missing or ambiguous, validation must fail, not choose an alternative.

Use only existing foreach, value, field, flatten, lookup and typed bindings. Keep flatten operands actual arrays of arrays. Both lookup validations must execute before navigation. No schema widening, architecture change, extra discovery unless genuinely needed, limit increase, consent action or business selection change. Keep product-page extraction and bounded formatting as in revision 6, except adapting the original-record field references. Return the complete proposal; this is not artifact execution approval.
